entries.56a0ffce61a5467d: A single segment that manufactures and sells household daily goods, including deodorizing air fresheners, insect repellents, dehumidifiers, hand warmers, gloves and cat toilet products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥48,492 million, broken down by category as follows: Air Care (deodorizing air fresheners) ¥21,602 million; Clothing Care (insect repellents) ¥6,650 million; Hand Care (gloves) ¥5,540 million; Home Care (food care, cleaners and others) ¥4,446 million; Thermo Care (hand warmers) ¥3,971 million; Pet Care (cat toilet products) ¥3,778 million; and Moisture Care (dehumidifiers) ¥2,503 million.
entries.57f917e676ee0222: It is a manufacturer of household daily goods headquartered in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo.
